results.title: Dusk.com uses AI for support, not humans | Jonathon Speed posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.content:
explicitly stated I actually thought they being helpful at first and followed up for more info, and I'm ashamed to say it took me three emails in total before I realised it was a bot. Am I cross? A little. But I'm mostly embarrassed I fell for it. I genuinely thought email would be a way to get a meaningful answer. I'd assumed a chat would be a bot, but not an email. I'd have happily waited a few days for a full answer. Instead, they've lost me as a customer, and I'm espousing their poor [...] Proof of personhood is the most underrated market op of 2025. Everyone is complaining about bots. Companies aren't doing much about it. There is no reason to fix it. Bots generate revenue. Bots create fake engagement, which sell ads. There is no reason to change. ...until there is. Slowly, then all at once. Someday, we will wake up to a broken social media. We will wonder where the humans went. We will wonder where the subscriptions/follow features went. Bot content will be algorithmically [...] How frustrating. I increasingly feel we need legislation on this, perhaps to make it obligatory for LLM-generated communications to be explicitly marked as such. Obviously that wouldn't help prevent actual scams but I think the cumulative damage to customer trust from this sort of trick risks causing real economic damage in the near future. Also, in my experience, if the website answered the question I wouldn't be talking to the LLM in the first place 😁

results.title: The bots are broken. :: Awesomenauts General Discussions
results.content: So what's the point of this thread? To state that the bots are broken (even though most players realize this already) and to elaborate in detail. People have made threads like this before but I wanted to go the extra mile to explore as much as I could. I felt that these countless hours of me playing against these bots perhaps wouldn't be for nothing if I could share with other people my findings and maybe find ways to fix them. I know that some of the bot creators no longer update their bots, [...] YURI BOT: Please remove this bot from the game unless/until he gets fixed. On Sorona and AI Station in particular, he just flies around the top area and barely goes anywhere else. On those maps you can pretty much ignore him, just let him fly around over there while you push his turrets, he's unlikely to come help. [...] Some of this might come across as simple bug reporting but part of this thread is also complaints about the questionable decisions made to "balance" the bots. Which are not bugs, they are deliberate. That's why this isn't in the Tech Support & Bugs section. A large section of this thread will not be relevant to that section, that's why it's in General Discussion. I don't see deliberate additions in order to make the bots cheating pieces of \\\ as "bugs" and this certainly isn't technical
